purpose: Authoritative Utah SBIR/STTR award records, enriched with derived industry and funding-path tags so founders can identify comparable award paths and public principal investigators.
data_handling: Public principal-investigator names/titles are retained when supplied in the official award file. Phone numbers, email addresses, and agency-side award-contact fields are intentionally excluded.
enrichment_note: Industry tags are derived from public award titles, abstracts, agency, and branch. They are retrieval aids, not official SBA classifications.
